subject: Phased burn and commit alignment for Q3 launch
messages:
From: Sara Nguyen <sara@pixelplay.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:32:00 -0700
Subject: Phased commit proposal for Q3 launch

Hi Dylan,

Quick note from PixelPlay as we prep for our Q3 product launch: our token consumption will be lumpy — two soft-launch weeks in July, then a heavy public launch in mid-August followed by steady growth through September. Attached is our forecast (month-by-week).

High-level ask: we want a monthly commit that scales across three months (phased burn) rather than a single large up-front commit. Can Redwood propose a per-token discount schedule tied to monthly committed volumes, and also include a short-term surge buffer for launch spikes so we don't get throttled?

Constraints: runway sensitivity — we can't commit more than ~$25k/month cash outlay in the early months, but we can scale if launch metrics look good. Also would prefer monthly true-ups vs. annual true-ups.

Attached: PixelPlay_Q3_forecast.xlsx

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call.

Sara
Sara Nguyen
Head of Infrastructure, PixelPlay
From: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
To: Sara Nguyen <sara@pixelplay.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Phased commit proposal for Q3 launch

Sara — thanks for the forecast, this is helpful. I ran some initial numbers with Laura and sketched a phased commit that keeps your early-month cash exposure lower while unlocking steeper per-token discounts as you scale. See the attached spreadsheet for line-item math.

Proposal (example):
- Month 1 (soft launch): commit 50M tokens @ $0.00080/token (approx 5% discount vs list)
- Month 2 (ramp): commit 150M tokens @ $0.00070/token (approx 12% discount)
- Month 3 (full launch): commit 300M tokens @ $0.00060/token (approx 20% discount)

We can also offer:
- A 10% overage credit on the first month of any overage (to cover unexpected spikes during launch).
- Monthly true-up billing so you only pay for the committed tier or actual usage, whichever is higher; true-ups reconcile at month-end.
- A short-term surge buffer (capacity-wise) for the first 14 days after your public launch — this is operational (we reserve burst capacity) and doesn't require higher commit if used sparingly.

Attached: proposed_commit_schedule_v1.xlsx

If that structure looks roughly right, we can move to a DocuSign-ready term sheet and adjust volumes/price points to match your cash constraints. Would you prefer an initial pilot month at smaller commit to de-risk?

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Sara Nguyen <sara@pixelplay.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Phased commit proposal for Q3 launch

Thanks Dylan — appreciate the clear math. A couple of constraints from finance: we can't sign up for a 300M commit in month 3 without seeing traction; our runway limits the first-month cash commit to closer to 40M tokens.

Counter-proposal:
- Month 1: 40M commit
- Month 2: 120M commit
- Month 3: 220M commit

Additionally, we'd like the final-tier discount to be 25% off list (your ~ $0.00057/token target) if we hit 220M in month 3. We can accept a lower discount if you include a stronger overage cushion during the 2-week launch window (e.g., staged credits that kick in automatically).

Can you model pricing for the counter-proposal and confirm if DocuSign + monthly billing works for Redwood? We'd like a pilot provisioning date no later than July 1.

Attachment: PixelPlay_counter.xlsx

—Sara
From: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
To: Sara Nguyen <sara@pixelplay.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Phased commit proposal for Q3 launch

Sara — thanks, that counter is reasonable and helpful. We ran sensitivity scenarios against your forecast and here is a middle-ground we can commit to:

Revised offer:
- Month 1: 40M @ $0.00082/token (small premium to reflect lower initial commit)
- Month 2: 120M @ $0.00072/token
- Month 3: 220M @ $0.00057/token (equivalent to ~25% off list) if you hit the 220M threshold; otherwise fallback price is $0.00062/token

Launch protections:
- Automatic 14-day surge buffer with up to 20% above the committed month at no extra charge for the first launch month.
- If you exceed the buffer, overage will be billed at the fallback price for the remainder of that month but we'll cap incremental billing to an agreed ceiling and issue a 10% credit on that overage as a one-time launch goodwill.

Commercials and cadence:
- Monthly true-up and invoice (net 30).
- DocuSign term sheet prepared — will include explicit measurement points for the 220M threshold and the automatic surge rules.

Next steps: I can send the DocuSign and the revised schedule (attached) for legal review and provisioning if you confirm the provisioning target (you mentioned July 1).

Attachments: proposed_commit_schedule_final.xlsx

—Dylan
From: Sara Nguyen <sara@pixelplay.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Phased commit proposal for Q3 launch

Dylan — this works for us. We accept the revised offer and would like to proceed with DocuSign and provisioning.

Confirm provisioning target: July 1. Please loop in support/ops so we can coordinate keys and any network peering for the extra burst capacity. Pedro from infrastructure will be our day-to-day; I'll forward his contact once legal signs.

Quick note re: billing — we prefer to have invoices routed to finance@pixelplay.com and copied to me.

Thanks, looking forward to the pilot.
